standard: Teaching standard 1.10 and fixed M101 opening v0.4, inspected local text; OU typography PNG inspected.

comparators.source: Private OU MST124 Unit 5, printed p.183, scalar product definition, Figure 55 and Activity 51
comparators.use: Q2 geometry and notation; readable vector symbols, fraction/radical/delimiter conventions. Private image inspected; no source content republished. This is a taught activity, not an OU TMA; no external assessment equivalence claimed.

Inspected actual dot-product, angle, scalar/vector projection and decomposition questions. Original Q2 combines these taught operations with an explicit zero-direction qualification. No molecular geometry, direction-cosine theorem or calculus required.

comparators.source: Margalit and Rabinoff, Interactive Linear Algebra §3.4.1–3.4.3
comparators.use: Inspected exposition of chaining actions, row-column calculation and noncommutative composition. Q3 restricts to two dimensions and asks the learner to justify action order. General-dimensional transformation proofs excluded.

comparators.source: Nicholson, Linear Algebra with Applications §2.4E, Exercises 1(a,d), 2(a,b)
comparators.use: Read actual two-by-two inverse calculation and inverse-product questions. Excluded larger matrices and symbolic generalisations. Source answer indexing and Ex1(b) appear inconsistent; calculated original answers independently, never using that answer list as an oracle.

local_prerequisites.Q1: M101 U01 coordinates, displacement, magnitude/unit vectors and angles; no velocity laws.
local_prerequisites.Q2: M101 U02 scalar/cross products and signed projection; original L02 prose and zero cases reviewed.
local_prerequisites.Q3: M101 U03 L01–L02 and L05, columns/composition/determinant/inverse.
local_prerequisites.Q4: M101 U03 L03–L04, reversible elimination and completeness of parameter families; three-unknown question supplies an elimination sequence.
local_prerequisites.Q5: M101 U03 L05–L06 and P101 U01 L04–L05; flat-list arithmetic and reusable functions, no libraries.

gaps: No private OU TMA or independently moderated timed assessment was available.
